name: Version history
oneLiner: a sheet of real paper sits beside a glass version list; the highlight scrubs down the list back in time and the page changes with each step (the title, the paragraphs, the brand screenshot dropping out), lands on an older version, a cursor clicks Restore and the page snaps back with a green Restored badge while the top of the list takes the old version
say: when the speaker says they went back to an older version ('I rolled it back to yesterday', 'every change is saved, you can always go back'): the scrub runs under 'went back', the Restore click lands on 'restored' or 'yesterday'
